verdict.rationale: The public business pages offer a business database search (docs-8), certificate of good standing and certificate validation (docs-10), and email notifications (docs-11), and the tax pages offer a 'Where's my refund?' online status check (docs-18). Together these let a founder see entity standing and tax-return status from public pages, and a keyless business-entities data API returns JSON (probe-1). However, nothing shows a tracker for a specific pending business filing, application, or case. missing for 10: explicit status lookup for submitted business filings or applications, case/complaint status tracking, documentation of what status fields the business search exposes, independent hands-on corroboration.
